profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc describes itself as the leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation. The company says the world's most influential organizations trust Pega to reimagine work by automating workflows, personalizing customer experiences, and modernizing legacy systems. It states that since 1983, the world's largest organizations have trusted Pega to turn transformation ambition into durable results.

The company's latest platform release, Infinity 26, is described as designed to help enterprises build, orchestrate, and scale AI with greater predictability, control, and measurable value. Pega says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight from the start, allowing an agentic workforce to be orchestrated end-to-end. Pega Platform is presented as making AI unified, predictable, and safe for mission-critical work. Pega Blueprint is an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together, combining best practices and governance.

Pegasystems Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA, with CIK 0001013857. The company has a Massachusetts law exposure count of 191.
